en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard view over a park and waterfront street with trams, cars, and boats. Large multi‑story buildings line the left side, while a harbor or river with several docked vessels appears on the right. The image is titled at the top in Swedish: "Stockholm – Utsikt från Operaterrassen" (Stockholm – View from the Opera Terrace). The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century cityscape.
